# dsh-ancient-echoes
Deterministic BaZi / Chinese metaphysics tools for **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)**.

This is a thin, read-only pass-through plugin: every dsh tool calls the hosted
Ancient Echoes Tools

API (`POST /api/v1/tools/<tool>`) and returns the same
structured result the AE web app, the REST AP

I and the AE MCP server use. No
calculation is re-implemented locally, and no chart is cached.

- Website / docs: <https://www.ancientechoes.ai/developers>
- MCP alternative: `https://www.anciente

choes.ai/api/v1/mcp` (Streamable HTTP)
- Skill / agent plugin repo: <https://github.com/FlamesCN/anc

mcp` (Streamable HTTP)
- Skill / agent plugin repo: <https://github.com/FlamesCN/ancient-echoes-mcp>

rence, never the value):

plugin/console session: `await ctx.credentials.set(credentialRef('ANCIENT_ECHOES_TOKEN'), 'sk-…')`.

The store lives in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` (readable only by your OS user),
wins over environm

ent variables, and a rotated value applies to the next call
without restarting the harness.

`config.apiKey` still exists as an explicit override, but it is plain text and
`dsh --dump-config` p
rints it — prefer the credential store.
## Configuration
| Key | Default | Meaning |
| `apiKeyRef` | `ANCIENT_ECHOES_TOKEN` | Credential reference resolved per call from the dsh credent

ial store, then the environment. |
| `apiKey` | `''` | Explicit plain-text override (shown by `--dum

p-config`; for local debugging only). |
| `baseUrl` | `https://www.ancientechoes.ai` | Site root; po

int at a local backend for development. |
| `tools` | `core` | `core`, `all` (all 38 registry tools)

, or an explicit array of AE/dsh tool names. |
| `toolPrefix` | `''` | Prefix every registered tool

name, e.g. `ae_`. |
| `timeoutMs` | `45000` | Per-call deadline; forwards cancellation from the harn

ess. |
| `maxResultChars` | `60000` | Model-facing result cap; the canonical value is kept intact. |

The plugin adds one extra tool, `<prefix>ancient_echoes_guide`, that returns the
condensed usage gui
de (field conventions, error codes, privacy bounds).
## Tools
`tools: core` registers:
| dsh tool | AE tool |

| `bazi_calculate_chart` | `bazi.calculate_chart` |
| `bazi_compare_charts` | `bazi.compare_charts`

|
| `bazi_analyze_wealth` | `bazi.analyze_wealth` |
| `ziwei_calculate_chart` | `ziwei.calculate_cha

rt` |
| `lingxi_rag_search` | `lingxi.rag_search` |
| `lingxi_rag_query` | `lingxi.rag_query` |
| `a

lmanac_get_day` | `almanac.get_day` |
| `election_find_good_days` | `election.find_good_days` |
| `d

ivination_preview_liuyao` | `divination.preview_liuyao` |
| `divination_preview_meihua` | `divinatio

iuyao` | `divination.preview_liuyao` |
| `divination_preview_meihua` | `divination.preview_meihua` |

`tools: all` registers every tool the AE registry exposes (BaZi, Ziwei, Qimen,
Qizheng, Vedic, Weste

rn astrology, 13 divination methods, election, almanac,
RAG). Tool names and parameter schemas are g

enerated from the AE OpenAPI
document (`schema/openapi.json` snapshot, `AE Tools API 1.3.0`).

Every successful result carries `api_version`, `request_id`,
`calculation { capability, version }` a

nd `data`. Quote the calculation version
when you relay a result; different versions must not be mix

`data`. Quote the calculation version
when you relay a result; different versions must not be mixed.
## Errors
Errors keep the AE machine-readable code and add an actionable hint:
| Code | Meaning |
| `tool_entitlement_required` | The account's plan does not include this tool. Tell the user; do not

swap in another tool. |
| `tool_quota_exceeded` | 200 calls/day, 30 calls/minute. Honour `Retry-Aft

er`. |
| `tool_scope_required` | The key lacks `tools:read` / `tools:invoke`; re-issue it in AE deve

loper settings. |
| `unauthorized` | Missing or invalid key. |
| `invalid_argument`, `tool_invocatio
n_failed` | Fix the arguments; not a service outage. |
## Auth and safety

- **Every remote tool requires a credential.** Each call resolves `apiKeyRef`
(credential store → en

vironment) and refuses before any network I/O when it is
absent. The only credential-free tool is `<

prefix>ancient_echoes_guide`, which
returns bundled text and makes no request.
- The credential is r

esolved per call and never echoed into tool output, logs, or
rendered values. A rotated stored value

applies on the next call.
- Read-only: the plugin registers tools only. It never writes files, runs

shells, or reaches the network except `baseUrl`.
- Birth data travels only as the arguments of one

call; nothing is cached.
- Results are reference material: structured evidence plus calculation
vers

ions. No deterministic predictions, no medical / legal / investment
advice.
- **What ships:** compil

ed `lib/` only — no `src/`, no schema snapshot, no tests,
no `.env`, no credentials. `npm run check:

pack` fails the pack if the tarball
grows an unexpected file or matches a secret pattern.
- dsh is p

re-1.0 and will break compatibility; `engines.dsh` is pinned to
`<0.3.0` and every release should be

validated against a concrete dsh
version.
